question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box: 0.
stimulus: | require | be | provide | spread | promote | | define | anticipate | direct | remain | stay | E-Commerce is rapidly being (a) ______ in our country. It may be (b) ______ as a business process through electronic transition. Buyers and sellers are not (c) ______ to talk face to face. We may get our required product (d) ______ at home. One of the best opportunities (e) ______ that businessmen from home and abroad can (f) ______ their business using this system (g) ______ in their respective countries. It (h) ______ us with global information, resources and services. It is (i) ______ that it will (j) ______ our domestic business very soon.
guide_solution: Complete the text with right forms of verbs: (a) spread (b) defined (c) required (d) provided (e) is (f) promote (g) remaining (h) provides (i) anticipated (j) promote
